А то!{E108:0010} Второй, поди, и был тот самый
наш главарь.

entries.en:
Anyway,{E108:0008} yabber, yabber, yabber,{E108:0008} on it goes for a little
while, then --{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}"AAAAAH!" --{E108:0008} a scream!
entries.ru:
В общем,{E108:0008} лопочут, лопочут, лопочут,{E108:0008} а потом --{E108:000C}
{E107:0001}{E1D1}«А-А-А-А!» --{E108:0008} крик!

entries.en:
Well, that shook me up pretty good,{E108:0010} so I hunkered
down in my hidin' place and tried to stay outta sight.
entries.ru:
Меня аж всю затрясло,{E108:0010} вот я и вжалась
в своё укрытие, чтоб не углядели.

entries.en: So you didn't see the moment of the murder?
entries.ru: Значит, самого убийства вы не видели?

entries.en: Naw,{E108:0008} but I heard it real good!
entries.ru: Не-а,{E108:0008} зато слышала преотлично!

entries.en: You didn't try and help whoever was being attacked?
entries.ru: А помочь тому, на кого напали, вы не пробовали?

entries.en: Quit tryna be funny, girlie.{E108:0010} It don't suit ya none.
entries.ru: Не остроумничайте, девонька.{E108:0010} Вам это не идёт.

entries.en:
I'm just a dainty little journalist all on her lonesome.{E108:0010}
Ya think I was fixin' to jump in an' save the day!?
entries.ru:
Я тут одна-одинёшенька, хрупкая журналистка.{E108:0010}
Думаете, я кинулась бы всех спасать!?

entries.en: (..."Dainty"?)
entries.ru: (...«Хрупкая»?)

entries.en: Anyhow,{E108:0008} then there was a buncha rustlin' sounds...
entries.ru: Потом,{E108:0008} значит, пошла всякая возня да шорохи...

entries.en:
Right about when that was happenin',{E108:0008} I got to feelin'
pretty bad about what I'd done...
entries.ru:
Вот тут-то мне и стало{E108:0008} совестно
за то, что я натворила...

entries.en:
That makes sense, I guess.{E108:0010}
After all,{E108:0008} you didn't--
entries.ru:
Оно и понятно.{E108:0010}
Вы ведь{E108:0008} так и не--

entries.en:
I didn't remember to get out my camera an' snap even
a single picture!
entries.ru:
Я и не догадалась достать камеру
да щёлкнуть хоть разочек!

entries.en:
Scoop like that drops right in my lap,{E108:0008} an' I miss it!{E108:0018}
Somebody oughta tan my hide!
entries.ru:
Такая сенсация сама в руки идёт,{E108:0008} а я мимо!{E108:0018}
Выпороть меня некому!

entries.en:
Anyhow,{E108:0008} then a little more time goes by, and there's
this kinda clatterin' noise.
entries.ru:
В общем,{E108:0008} проходит ещё сколько-то, и слышу
какой-то грохот.

entries.en:
I'm there thinkin'{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}"Gotta get the shot this time!",{E108:0010} {E107:0002}and so
I grab one real quick from in the shadows there.
entries.ru:
Думаю себе:{E108:000C} {E107:0001}{E1D1}«Уж теперь-то не упущу!»{E108:0010} {E107:0002}-- и живо
щёлкаю из темноты.

entries.en: ...Could we see this photograph?
entries.ru: ...Можно взглянуть на снимок?

entries.en: Th-That's--!
entries.ru: Э-Это же--!

entries.en:
The person in the red raincoat!{E108:0010}
The one who attacked Kay!
entries.ru:
Человек в красном плаще!{E108:0010}
Тот, кто напал на Кей!

entries.en:
(So Kay's raincoated assailant also attacked the victim
here in the storeroom...)
entries.ru:
(Значит, напавший на Кей человек в плаще
убил и жертву здесь, в кладовой...)

entries.en:
(Then proceeded up to the roof, where they assaulted
Kay?)
entries.ru:
(А потом поднялся на крышу
и там напал на Кей?)

entries.en: Weird, huh?{E108:0010} I wondered the same thing.
entries.ru: Странно, да?{E108:0010} Я и сама удивилась.

entries.en:
Heard two people,{E108:0008} but there was only one in the shot
I got.
entries.ru:
Слышала двоих,{E108:0008} а на снимке вышел
только один.

entries.en:
And I didn't see nobody nowhere else in the room,
neither.
entries.ru: И больше в комнате никого нигде не было.

entries.en:
But that's the killer, alright.{E108:0010} Leastways,{E108:0008} I'm pretty sure
it is.
entries.ru:
А это убийца, точно.{E108:0010} Во всяком случае,{E108:0008}
я почти уверена.

entries.en: (So are we saying the {E043}victim disappeared{E042}...?){E106}{E198:0003000C}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12F:00000008}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}How did you know it was the killer just by looking?
entries.ru: (Выходит, {E043}жертва исчезла{E042}...?){E106}{E198:0003000C}{E100:0001}{E1AE}{E12F:00000008}{E100:0000}{E101:00000000}{E107:0002}Как вы по одному взгляду поняли, что это убийца?

entries.en:
Because they're literally red-handed with blood!{E108:0018}
How else would that get there, huh?
entries.ru:
Да у него руки в крови -- в самом прямом смысле!{E108:0018}
Откуда б ей там взяться, а?

entries.en: And the auction just carried on after that?
entries.ru: И аукцион после этого просто продолжился?

entries.en:
Sure did!{E108:0010} They just went right along like nothin' had
happened!
entries.ru:
Ещё как!{E108:0010} Дальше пошло как ни в чём
не бывало!

entries.en:
Rich folks is crazier than a box o' frogs!{E108:0010}
I'll never understand how they think!
entries.ru:
У богатых в голове не все дома!{E108:0010}
Вовек мне их не понять!

entries.en:
(Funny.{E108:0010} I find journalists a struggle to understand as
well...)
entries.ru:
(Забавно.{E108:0010} Журналистов мне понять
тоже нелегко...)

entries.en:
Ms. Hart's Statement data jotted down
in my Organizer.
entries.ru:
Данные «Показания Харт» записаны
в органайзер.

entries.en: I hope I've been of help to you so far...
entries.ru: Надеюсь, я хоть чем-то вам помогла...

entries.en:
Ahh!{E108:0010} Careful with that!{E108:0018}
You can't go around spraying others with luminol!
entries.ru:
Ай!{E108:0010} Осторожнее!{E108:0018}
Люминолом в людей не брызгают!

entries.en: I,{E108:0008} I wasn't about to...
entries.ru: Я,{E108:0008} я и не собирался...

entries.en:
I...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}keep feeling like there's something {E107:0003}just on the edge
of my memory...
entries.ru:
Я...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}всё время чувствую, будто что-то {E107:0003}вертится
у самого края памяти...

entries.en: There is!?{E108:0010} It could be the clue we need!
entries.ru: Правда!?{E108:0010} Это может быть нужной зацепкой!

entries.en:
Alright,{E108:0008} just let it float to the top of your mind,{E108:0008} and say
whatever comes into your thoughts.
entries.ru:
Хорошо,{E108:0008} просто дай ему всплыть само,{E108:0008} и говори
всё, что придёт в голову.

entries.en:
I'm seeing a small restaurant...{E108:0010} Just a counter and
some seats...{E108:0010} And there's this...{E108:0008} incredible smell...
entries.ru:
Вижу маленькую закусочную...{E108:0010} Стойка и
несколько стульев...{E108:0010} И такой...{E108:0008} дивный запах...

entries.en:
A beautiful,{E108:0008} golden soup...{E108:0010} Not too thick...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}And it tastes just right...
entries.ru:
Прекрасный,{E108:0008} золотистый бульон...{E108:0010} Не густой...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}И на вкус ровно такой, как надо...

entries.en:
It's filled with...{E108:0008} delicious noodles...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}They're firm, but...{E108:0008} not too firm...
entries.ru:
А в нём...{E108:0008} чудесная лапша...{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Упругая, но...{E108:0008} не слишком упругая...

entries.en: And that's when a thought crossed my mind...!
entries.ru: И тут мне в голову пришла мысль...!

entries.en: ...I'm going to order another bowl!
entries.ru: ...Закажу-ка ещё тарелку!

entries.en:
(A-A captivating memory...{E108:0010} but sadly,{E108:0008} one that has
nothing to do with the case.)
entries.ru:
(У-Увлекательное воспоминание...{E108:0010} но, увы,{E108:0008}
к делу оно отношения не имеет.)

entries.en:
You used to say you were the second Great Thief
Yatagarasu.
entries.ru:
Ты называла себя Вторым Ятагарасу,
великим вором.

entries.en: A noble outlaw,{E108:0008} dedicated to stealing the truth.
entries.ru: Благородной разбойницей,{E108:0008} что крадёт правду.

entries.en: Do you really not remember any of that?
entries.ru: И ты правда ничего этого не помнишь?

entries.en: I think you're right!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}I was a noble!
entries.ru: Кажется, вы правы!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Я была из благородных!

entries.en:
(Not a noble, Kay.{E108:0010} A noble outlaw.{E108:0018}
Still,{E108:0008} I suppose you got halfway there...)
entries.ru:
(Не из благородных, Кей.{E108:0010} Благородной разбойницей.{E108:0018}
Впрочем,{E108:0008} полдороги ты прошла...)

entries.en: ...I'm sorry.
entries.ru: ...Мои соболезнования.

entries.en:
I don't remember you well enough to accept a gift like
that just yet.
entries.ru:
Я вас ещё слишком плохо помню, чтобы
принимать такие подарки.

entries.en:
Th-That's alright.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}I wasn't offering it to you anyway...
entries.ru:
В-Всё в порядке.{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Я тебе его и не дарил...

entries.en: Is that...{E108:0010} for somebody who protects people?
entries.ru: Это...{E108:0010} для тех, кто защищает людей?

entries.en: Is it...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}a hero of justice's pin...?
entries.ru: Это...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}значок героя правосудия...?

entries.en: No.{E108:0010} It's a prosecutor's badge.
entries.ru: Нет.{E108:0010} Это прокурорский значок.

entries.en: I believe you're thinking of an attorney's badge.
entries.ru: Ты, полагаю, думаешь об адвокатском.

entries.en:
I feel like somebody I know used to have one...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}Somebody important...
entries.ru:
Кажется, у кого-то знакомого такой был...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}У кого-то очень важного...

entries.en: (Her father was a prosecutor.)
entries.ru: (Её отец был прокурором.)

entries.en:
(I suppose perhaps she's recalling flashes of her
childhood...)
entries.ru: (Видимо, всплывают обрывки детства...)

entries.en: You like pins, huh, Mr. Edgeworth?
entries.ru: Вы любите значки, мистер Эджворт?

entries.en:
I...{E108:0018}
Not particularly,{E108:0008} no.
Still,{E108:0008} you always seem to have one on you.
entries.ru: И всё-таки{E108:0008} у вас вечно при себе какой-нибудь.

entries.en:
It's a part of the job, I'm afraid.{E108:0010}
And this one is also a piece of evidence.
entries.ru:
Такая работа, увы.{E108:0010}
А этот к тому же улика.

entries.en:
Oh.{E108:0010} So you carry things you don't like around as a
form of willpower training!?
entries.ru:
А.{E108:0010} Значит, вы носите нелюбимые вещи
для закалки воли!?

entries.en: ...That's not it at all.
entries.ru: ...Вовсе нет.

entries.en:
I remember the person in the red raincoat...{E108:0010}
That much I'm pretty sure of...
entries.ru:
Человека в красном плаще я помню...{E108:0010}
Вот в этом я почти уверена...

entries.en:
But were they really coming toward you from beyond
the concession stand?
entries.ru:
Но правда ли он шёл к тебе оттуда,
из-за лотка?

entries.en: Yes.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}They were walking right toward me.
entries.ru: Да.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Он шёл прямо на меня.

entries.en:
And I have proof!{E108:0010} Of course I do!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I remember they had legs!
entries.ru:
И доказательство есть!{E108:0010} Конечно есть!{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Я помню, что у него были ноги!

entries.en:
But there's nothing out there beyond the stand.{E108:0010}
How could they have been walking on thin air?
entries.ru:
Но за лотком ничего нет.{E108:0010}
Как он мог идти по воздуху?

entries.en: I don't know...{E108:0010} Maybe...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}they were a ghost?
entries.ru: Не знаю...{E108:0010} Может...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}это было привидение?

entries.en:
...A ghost?{E108:0010} I'm sorry, Kay,{E108:0010} {E12F:00000008}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}but ghosts don't exist.{E108:0010}
They are the very antithesis of science!
entries.ru:
...Привидение?{E108:0010} Прости, Кей,{E108:0010} {E12F:00000008}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}но привидений нет.{E108:0010}
Они — полная противоположность науке!

entries.en:
Then this...{E108:0010} is one of those "contradiction" things,
huh...
entries.ru:
Значит, это...{E108:0010} то самое «противоречие»,
да...

entries.en: Is this some kind of...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}contract?
entries.ru: Это что-то вроде...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}договора?

entries.en:
In a way.{E108:0010} It appears to be a criminal contract of sorts,{E108:0008}
I suppose you could say.
entries.ru:
В своём роде.{E108:0010} Это, если угодно,{E108:0008}
преступный договор.

entries.en:
The letter isn't handwritten,{E108:0008} so it's hard to say who
actually wrote it.
entries.ru:
Письмо не от руки,{E108:0008} так что кто его писал
на самом деле -- сказать трудно.

entries.en: That's a really cute toy.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}It's...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}a cow, right?
entries.ru: Какая милая игрушка.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Это...{E108:0010} {E188:002F0000}корова, да?

entries.en: Yes.{E108:0010} It appears to be.
entries.ru: Да.{E108:0010} Судя по всему.

entries.en:
You and me --{E108:0008} we saw it somewhere else not so long
ago.
entries.ru:
Мы с тобой{E108:0008} видели её недавно
в другом месте.

entries.en:
It's missing a horn...{E108:0018}
Who would hurt a toy like{E107:0007}.........
entries.ru:
У неё рожка нет...{E108:0018}
Кто ж её сломал{E107:0007}.........

entries.en: Kay!{E108:0018} What's the matter!?
entries.ru: Кей!{E108:0018} Что с тобой!?

entries.en:
I don't know, but...{E108:0010} {E1D1}looking at the cow toy,{E108:0008} it...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}It made my head hurt really bad...!
entries.ru:
Не знаю, но...{E108:0010} {E1D1}когда я смотрю на корову,{E108:0008} она...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}{E1D2}От неё голова разболелась ужасно...!

entries.en: (Nngh...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I'd better not make her look at it any longer.)
entries.ru: (Нгх...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Пусть больше на неё не смотрит.)

entries.en: That's them!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}That's the person who pushed me!
entries.ru: Это он!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Это он меня столкнул!

entries.en: You still don't remember their face?
entries.ru: Лица его ты по-прежнему не помнишь?

entries.en: Which is it, Kay?{E108:0010} Are you sure or are you not?
entries.ru: Так как же, Кей?{E108:0010} Уверена или нет?

entries.en:
I,{E108:0008} I don't know...{E108:0010} When you look at me like that, I...{E108:0010}
My mind just goes blank...
entries.ru:
Я,{E108:0008} я не знаю...{E108:0010} Когда вы так смотрите, я...{E108:0010}
У меня всё из головы вылетает...

entries.en:
Never mind me --{E108:0010} what about the person in the
picture?
entries.ru:
Не обо мне речь --{E108:0010} что с человеком
на снимке?

entries.en:
I...{E108:0008} don't know...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}The raincoat is all I'm sure of.
entries.ru:
Я...{E108:0008} не знаю...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Уверена я только в плаще.

entries.en: (Which means that Kay can't be the murderer.)
entries.ru: (Значит, Кей убийцей быть не может.)

entries.en: (I just have to find more evidence to support my case.)
entries.ru: (Осталось найти больше улик в подтверждение.)

entries.en:
I was carrying this, wasn't I?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}...I'm sorry.{E108:0010} I don't remember anything about it.
entries.ru:
Это было при мне, да?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}...Простите.{E108:0010} Я про него ничего не помню.

entries.en:
Nothing at all?{E108:0018}
Even the tiniest clue could help.
entries.ru:
Совсем ничего?{E108:0018}
Любая мелочь может помочь.

entries.en:
I think I might have just grabbed it on reflex when
whatever happened to me happened!
entries.ru:
Наверное, я схватилась за него машинально,
когда со мной это случилось!

entries.en:
There's a saying, right?{E108:0010}
"A falling person will clutch at a straw"?
entries.ru:
Есть же поговорка?{E108:0010}
«Падающий хватается за соломинку»?

entries.en: What's the matter?{E108:0010} You're making a strange face.
entries.ru: Что такое?{E108:0010} У вас странное лицо.

entries.en:
...I don't want to dissuade you from trying,{E108:0010} but please,{E108:0008}
I need you to think a little more before you speak.
entries.ru:
...Не хочу отбивать у тебя охоту,{E108:0010} но прошу,{E108:0008}
думай немного дольше, прежде чем говорить.

entries.en: I...{E108:0010} I understand.

Hoo boy,{E108:0008} this whole experience is enough to boggle a
guy's mind!
entries.ru:
Ух ты,{E108:0008} от такого у человека совсем
голова кругом!

entries.en:
Mysterious storerooms,{E108:0008} damsels in distress --{E108:0008} it's got
the lot!
entries.ru:
Тайные кладовые,{E108:0008} дева в беде --{E108:0008} всё
в одном флаконе!

entries.en:
...Could you at least try to take things a little more
seriously, Fender?
entries.ru:
...Не могли бы вы отнестись к делу
хоть немного серьёзнее, Защитин?

entries.en: Heh heh heh!{E108:0010} Hey,{E108:0008} I can TRY!
entries.ru: Хе-хе-хе!{E108:0010} Э,{E108:0008} ПОПРОБОВАТЬ-то могу!

entries.en:
No, but seriously,{E108:0008} I'm as keen to help Kay out as you
are.{E108:0010} She's safe with me.
entries.ru:
Нет, серьёзно,{E108:0008} я хочу помочь Кей не меньше
твоего.{E108:0010} Со мной она в безопасности.

entries.en: You go do your thing.
entries.ru: А ты давай, занимайся своим делом.

entries.en: (It's not Kay I'm worried about,{E108:0008} it's you...)
entries.ru: (Я не за Кей волнуюсь,{E108:0008} а за вас...)

entries.en:
Ahh!{E108:0010} Careful with that!{E108:0018}
You can't go around spraying others with luminol!
entries.ru:
Ай!{E108:0010} Осторожнее!{E108:0018}
Люминолом в людей не брызгают!

entries.en: I,{E108:0008} I wasn't about to...
entries.ru: Я,{E108:0008} я и не собирался...

entries.en: Ask me anything!{E108:0010} I'm all ears!
entries.ru: Спрашивайте что угодно!{E108:0010} Я вся внимание!

entries.en:
I can't believe they suspect poor Kay!{E108:0010}
It's outrageous!
entries.ru:
Как они могут подозревать бедную Кей!{E108:0010}
Это возмутительно!

entries.en:
I couldn't agree more.{E108:0010} But the best thing we can do
right now is to stay calm and look for clues.
entries.ru:
Совершенно согласен.{E108:0010} Но сейчас лучше всего
сохранять спокойствие и искать зацепки.

entries.en:
...Except!{E108:0010} I've been scientifically processing the
situation and I think I've come up with a better idea!
entries.ru:
...Вот только!{E108:0010} Я научно обработала обстановку
и, кажется, придумала кое-что получше!

entries.en:
Maybe we could administer some carefully targeted
electric shocks directly to Kay's brain.
entries.ru:
Что если подать точно нацеленные разряды тока
прямо Кей в мозг.

entries.en:
What do you say?{E108:0010} Might be just the thing to bring her
memory back online!
entries.ru:
Как вам?{E108:0010} Глядишь, память и включится
обратно!

entries.en:
Um...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}That sounds more than a little risky.{E108:0010}
It sounds incredibly risky, in fact.
entries.ru:
Э-э...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Это звучит рискованно.{E108:0010} И даже не «немного»
рискованно, а чудовищно.

entries.en:
Personally, I'm still of the opinion that searching this
room for clues is the better option.
entries.ru:
Лично я по-прежнему считаю, что осмотреть
эту комнату в поисках зацепок -- вариант получше.

entries.en: Really?{E108:0010} But a little risk is what science is all about...
entries.ru: Правда?{E108:0010} Но небольшой риск -- это и есть наука...

entries.en: (Yes,{E108:0008} "a little" being the operative phrase!)
entries.ru: (Вот именно,{E108:0008} что «небольшой»!)

entries.en:
I'm back for a little while to interpret for my professor,{E108:0008}
but I'm still mostly based in Europe.
entries.ru:
Я вернулась ненадолго -- переводить
для профессора,{E108:0008} а живу всё так же в Европе.

entries.en:
Gotta keep studying until I'm the finest forensic
investigator under the sun!
entries.ru:
Буду учиться, пока не стану лучшим
криминалистом на всём белом свете!

entries.en:
I'm very glad to hear you say that.{E108:0010} Dedication to one's
chosen field is a student's greatest responsibility.
entries.ru:
Очень рад это слышать.{E108:0010} Преданность избранному
делу -- главная обязанность студента.

entries.en:
It sure is!{E108:0010} But I don't just want to get ahead
academically.{E108:0010} I've been trying hard at sports, too!
entries.ru:
Ещё какая!{E108:0010} Но я хочу успевать не только
в учёбе.{E108:0010} Я и спортом занимаюсь вовсю!

entries.en:
Especially that one event they have at school athletics
meets --{E108:0010} you know the one!
entries.ru:
Особенно в одном виде на школьных
соревнованиях --{E108:0010} вы знаете, в каком!

entries.en: (Umm,{E108:0008} there are quite a few to choose from...)
entries.ru: (Э-э,{E108:0008} их там довольно много...)

entries.en:
It's huge over there.{E108:0010} And unlike here,{E108:0008} it's considered a
real hardcore sport for adults!
entries.ru:
Там это огромная тема.{E108:0010} И, в отличие от нас,{E108:0008}
это серьёзный взрослый спорт!

entries.en:
That's right!{E108:0008} I'm talking about...{E108:0010} {E285}glasses battles!{E108:0010}
Who hasn't heard of those, right?
entries.ru:
Вот именно!{E108:0008} Я говорю про...{E108:0010} {E285}очечные бои!{E108:0010}
Ну кто же о них не слышал, правда?

entries.en: (...Me.{E108:0010} Never.{E108:0010} Not even once.)

Ms. Hart sure seems to have a grudge against you,
Mr. Edgeworth.
entries.ru:
Мисс Харт, похоже, крепко на вас зуб точит,
мистер Эджворт.

entries.en:
"Low-down, dirty, jerk of a prosecuctor"...{E108:0010}
She really wasn't holding back.
entries.ru:
«Подлый, бессовестный прокуроришка»...{E108:0010}
Выражений она не выбирала.

entries.en: We've met a few times.{E108:0010} On one case in particular.
entries.ru:
Мы встречались несколько раз.{E108:0010}
На одном деле в особенности.

entries.en:
But let's not let her attitude and sudden appearance
distract us from the job at hand.
entries.ru:
Но не будем отвлекаться от дела из-за её тона
и внезапного появления.

entries.en:
We just need to gather all the facts and apply the
principles of logical reasoning.
entries.ru:
Нужно лишь собрать все факты и применить
правила логического рассуждения.

entries.en:
By following my methods,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}the truth will present itself 
soon enough.
entries.ru:
Если следовать моим методам,{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}истина проявится
сама собой.

entries.en: Low-down,{E108:0008} dirty journalists notwithstanding!
entries.ru: Невзирая на подлых,{E108:0008} бессовестных журналистов!

entries.en: Uhh, don't take this the wrong way, but...
entries.ru: Э-э, вы только не обижайтесь, но...

entries.en:
...did her calling you a low-down dirty jerk get to you,
Mr. Edgeworth?
entries.ru:
...вас задело, что она обозвала вас подлым
бессовестным прокуроришкой, мистер Эджворт?

entries.en:
Gnrk...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}D-{E108:0008}Don't be ridiculous!
entries.ru:
Гнрк...{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Н-{E108:0008}Не говори глупостей!

entries.en: I wonder why Ms. Hart is here in the first place...
entries.ru: И почему мисс Харт вообще здесь оказалась...

entries.en:
Since she brought that huge camera of hers,{E108:0008} I'm
guessing she's on the trail of a story, right?
entries.ru:
Раз она притащила свою здоровенную камеру,{E108:0008}
она, наверное, идёт по следу материала?

entries.en:
We know there's some kind of illicit trade related to
police evidence being operated out of this storeroom.
entries.ru:
Мы знаем, что из этой кладовой идёт какая-то
незаконная торговля уликами полиции.

entries.en:
I imagine she must have received a lead regarding
that.
entries.ru:
Думаю, до неё дошла какая-то наводка
об этом.

entries.en:
Well,{E108:0008} I know it's tough,{E108:0008} but you're going to have to ask
her about what she knows!
entries.ru:
Ну,{E108:0008} я понимаю, что неприятно,{E108:0008} но вам придётся
спросить у неё, что она знает!

entries.en:
You're right, Ema.{E108:0010}
(I really don't want to talk with her, though...)
entries.ru:
Ты права, Эма.{E108:0010}
(Хотя говорить с ней совсем не хочется...)

entries.en: This is Kay's pin, right?
entries.ru: Это ведь значок Кей?

entries.en:
It is.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}It's one of her most prized possessions.{E108:0010}
...And yet,{E108:0008} she doesn't even remember it.
entries.ru:
Он самый.{E108:0010} {E107:0002}Одна из самых дорогих ей вещей.{E108:0010}
...И при этом{E108:0008} она его не помнит.

entries.en:
Huh...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Maybe it just needs...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}a bit more pizzazz.
entries.ru:
Хм...{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}Может, ему просто не хватает...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}шика.

entries.en: I could customize it a little?{E108:0010} What do you think?
entries.ru: Я могла бы его чуть-чуть украсить.{E108:0010} Как вам?

entries.en:
A pink ribbon here,{E108:0008} a white feather there...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}We can have it looking pretty in no time!
entries.ru:
Розовую ленточку сюда,{E108:0008} белое пёрышко туда...{E108:0010}
{E107:0001}Мигом станет загляденье!

entries.en: Thank you, but...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I think we'd better leave it as it is.
entries.ru: Спасибо, но...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}пожалуй, лучше оставить как есть.

entries.en: (Lest we confuse Kay and her memories any further...)
entries.ru: (А то Кей и её память запутаются ещё сильнее...)

entries.en: Now why do you suppose Kay lost her memory?
entries.ru: А отчего, по-вашему, Кей потеряла память?

entries.en: She probably suffered some kind of huge shock, right?
entries.ru: Наверное, пережила какое-то сильное потрясение?

entries.en:
Well,{E108:0008} she did manage to get herself wrapped up in a
murder...
entries.ru:
Ну,{E108:0008} она ведь угодила в самую гущу
убийства...

entries.en:
Yeah.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I remember when it happened to me too,{E108:0008} a long
time ago.{E108:0010} I was so scared.
entries.ru:
Да.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Со мной ведь такое тоже было,{E108:0008}
давным-давно.{E108:0010} Мне было так страшно.

entries.en:
If it wasn't for my sister,{E108:0008} I wouldn't be standing here
talking with you right now like this.{E108:0010} That's for sure.
entries.ru:
Если бы не сестра,{E108:0008} я бы сейчас вот так
с вами не разговаривала.{E108:0010} Это уж точно.

entries.en:
...You have to help her,{E108:0008} okay, Mr. Edgeworth?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}You have to help Kay!
entries.ru:
...Вы ведь ей поможете,{E108:0008} мистер Эджворт?{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Вы должны помочь Кей!

entries.en: ...Of course.{E108:0010} That's exactly what I mean to do.
entries.ru: ...Разумеется.{E108:0010} Именно это я и намерен сделать.

entries.en: Auctioning off evidence!?{E108:0010} That's just wrong!
entries.ru:
Пускать улики с молотка!?{E108:0010}
Это же ни в какие ворота!

entries.en:
Indeed.{E108:0010} And inside the Committee for Prosecutorial
Excellence's own house, no less...
entries.ru:
Именно.{E108:0010} И, ни много ни мало, в самом доме
Комитета прокурорского совершенства...

entries.en:
It's not like we don't all want to look at this stuff!{E108:0010}
And play with it!{E108:0010} And spray it with various reagents!
entries.ru:
Ну да, всем нам хочется на это поглядеть!{E108:0010}
И повертеть в руках!{E108:0010} И побрызгать реактивами!

entries.en:
But selling it to the highest bidder?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}That's going too far!
entries.ru:
Но продавать тому, кто больше даст?{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}Это уже слишком!

entries.en:
I more or less agree...{E108:0010} with a portion of your
statements.
entries.ru:
Более или менее согласен...{E108:0010} с частью
сказанного.

entries.en:
When we finally catch who's doing this,{E108:0010} I'm going to
punish them,{E108:0010} scientifically!
entries.ru:
Когда мы их наконец поймаем,{E108:0010} я их накажу.{E108:0010}
По-научному!

entries.en: ...As long as you don't break the law while doing so.
entries.ru: ...Если только ты при этом не нарушишь закон.

entries.en: Are you interested in toys like this, Ema?
entries.ru: Тебе интересны такие игрушки, Эма?

entries.en:
Sure!{E108:0010} These materials...{E108:0010} The texture...{E108:0010}
Its density...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}It's pretty fascinating, actually!
entries.ru:
Ещё бы!{E108:0010} Эти материалы...{E108:0010} Фактура...{E108:0010}
Плотность...{E108:0010} {E107:0001}Это, между прочим, очень интересно!

entries.en:
Look,{E108:0008} you can tell from the way the fur is worn down
here that it was made quite a while ago!
entries.ru:
Смотрите,{E108:0008} по вытертому вот здесь ворсу видно,
что сделали его довольно давно!

entries.en: You said he was a "cutie" before...
entries.ru: Ты же сама только что звала его «милашкой»...

entries.en:
Yeah, he's cute,{E108:0008} but that was a totally different
conversation!
entries.ru:
Ну да, милашка,{E108:0008} но это был совсем
другой разговор!

entries.en:
(...Maybe I'm just not scientific enough to understand
how she compartmentalizes these features.)
entries.ru:
(...Видимо, я недостаточно научен, чтобы понять,
как у неё это раскладывается по полкам.)

entries.en: That's quite the pretty stain, huh?
entries.ru: А пятно-то красивое, правда?

entries.en: I'm not sure I feel comfortable rating bloodstains, Ema.
entries.ru:
Не уверен, что мне стоит оценивать
кровавые пятна, Эма.

entries.en:
Why not?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}There's all kinds to choose from!{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}You got your...
entries.ru:
Почему?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Их же полным-полно разных!{E108:0010}
{E107:0003}Вот, скажем...

entries.en:
...and that's just the ones I can think of off of the
top of my head!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Hey,{E108:0008} are you even listening!?
entries.ru:
...и это только то, что пришло мне
в голову навскидку!{E108:0018} {E107:0002}Эй,{E108:0008} вы вообще слушаете!?

entries.en: But really,{E108:0008} using luminol to detect--
entries.ru: А если серьёзно,{E108:0008} люминолом можно найти--

entries.en: Perhaps we should get back to our investigation.
entries.ru: Пожалуй, нам пора вернуться к расследованию.

entries.en: Aww!{E108:0010} But I'm not even halfway done!
entries.ru: Ну во-от!{E108:0010} Я и до половины не дошла!

entries.en: (Seriously?{E108:0010} Not even half?)
entries.ru: (Серьёзно?{E108:0010} Даже не до половины?)

entries.en:
I'm afraid there's not a whole lot for me to go on here,
Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010} Scientifically speaking, I mean.
entries.ru:
Боюсь, тут мне особо не за что зацепиться,
мистер Эджворт.{E108:0010} С научной точки зрения.

entries.en: In other words,{E108:0008} you're not sure what you're looking at?
entries.ru: Другими словами,{E108:0008} ты не понимаешь, на что смотришь?

entries.en:
No!{E108:0010} It's not a matter of not knowing!{E108:0018}
It's a matter of information!{E108:0018} {E280}I need more data!
entries.ru:
Нет!{E108:0010} Дело не в том, что я не понимаю!{E108:0018}
Дело в сведениях!{E108:0018} {E280}Мне нужно больше данных!

entries.en:
Examine what you want to test, Mr. Edgeworth,{E108:0008} and
let's spray it with some luminol!
entries.ru:
Осмотрите то, что хотите проверить,{E108:0008}
мистер Эджворт, -- и брызнем люминолом!

entries.en:
April 6
{E20D}Detention Center - Holding Cell
entries.ru:
6 апреля
{E20D}СИЗО, следственная камера

entries.en:
(Never thought I'd spend another night in here
again...)
entries.ru:
(Не думал, что снова проведу здесь
ночь...)

entries.en:
(And they stripped me of all the evidence we'd so
painstakingly gathered...)
entries.ru:
(И все улики, что мы с таким трудом собрали,
у меня отобрали...)

entries.en: (Even if they did let me keep Kay's {E1D5}{E1CB:00C400000000}Yatagarasu pin...)
entries.ru: (Правда, {E1D5}{E1CB:00C400000000}значок Ятагарасу Кей оставили...)

entries.en:
(I can't help but worry about her...{E108:0010}
{E284}They'd better be treating her well.)
entries.ru:
(Не могу за неё не тревожиться...{E108:0010}
{E284}Пусть бы с ней обращались по-человечески.)

entries.en: The murderer,{E108:0010} it...
entries.ru: Убийца,{E108:0010} это...

entries.en: It was me...
entries.ru: Это была я...

entries.en:
I remember...{E108:0008} looking down, and...{E108:003C}
The person in the red raincoat...{E108:0008} was on the ground...
entries.ru:
Помню...{E108:0008} я смотрю вниз, и...{E108:003C}
Человек в красном плаще...{E108:0008} лежит на полу...

entries.en:
It...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}It was me, Mr. Edgeworth!{E108:0018}
It was me all along!
entries.ru:
Это...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E188:00310000}{E1D1}Это была я, мистер Эджворт!{E108:0018}
Всё это время -- я!

entries.en: I'm the murderer!{E108:0010} {E107:0001}{E1D1}{E1D5}I'm the murderer!
Come on,{E108:0008} let's go.{E108:0010} {E1D1}You've got a visitor.
entries.ru: Так,{E108:0008} на выход.{E108:0010} {E1D1}К вам посетитель.
Посетитель?{E108:0010} {E107:0003}Кто?

entries.en:
Someone by the name of Dick Gumshoe.{E108:0010}
Want me to send 'em away?
entries.ru:
Некто Дик Гамшу.{E108:0010}
Прогнать?

entries.en:
...No.{E108:0018}
(Though I'm not sure what to even say to him...)
entries.ru:
...Нет.{E108:0018}
(Хотя и не знаю, что ему сказать...)

entries.en:
April 6
{E20D}Detention Center - Visitor's Room
entries.ru:
6 апреля
{E20D}СИЗО, комната свиданий

entries.en: Wait there.
entries.ru: Ждите здесь.

entries.en: (Hm?{E108:0010} They're leaving me unsupervised...?)
entries.ru: (Хм?{E108:0010} Меня оставляют без присмотра...?)

entries.en: Forgive the intrusion.
entries.ru: Простите за вторжение.

entries.en: Judge Gavèlle!
entries.ru: Судья Молотова!

entries.en:
Please, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
{E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000F}Take a seat.
entries.ru:
Прошу вас, мистер Эджворт.{E108:0010}
{E12F:0008000E}{E112:0008}{E12F:0008000F}Присаживайтесь.

entries.en:
What are you doing here?{E108:0010}
I was told it was Detective Gumshoe.
entries.ru:
Что вы здесь делаете?{E108:0010}
Мне сказали, пришёл детектив Гамшу.

entries.en: I imagined you wouldn't come if you knew it was me.
entries.ru: Я полагала, что, зная правду, вы бы не пришли.

entries.en: (What could she possibly want from me now?)
entries.ru: (Что ей теперь от меня понадобилось?)

entries.en: (I suppose I'd better find out...)
entries.ru: (Что ж, придётся выяснить...)

entries.en:
Ms. Faraday is currently being interrogated about her
involvement in the murder.
entries.ru:
Мисс Фарадей сейчас допрашивают о её
участии в убийстве.

entries.en:
You and the Committee...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}You know what you're doing, don't you?
entries.ru:
Вы и Комитет...{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Вы ведь понимаете, что делаете?

entries.en:
You know that the wrongful arrest and persecution of
an innocent person is beyond reprehensible!
entries.ru:
Вы понимаете, что арестовать невиновного
и травить его -- это гнусность!

entries.en:
That's quite the slanderous remark...{E108:0010} I would ask that
you frame your outbursts with a little more care.
entries.ru:
Это уже клевета...{E108:0010} Я попросила бы вас
выбирать выражения в своих порывах.

entries.en:
Besides,{E108:0008} she is not innocent.{E108:0010}
{E284}You merely wish that she is.
entries.ru:
К тому же{E108:0008} невиновной она не является.{E108:0010}
{E284}Вам лишь хочется, чтобы это было так.

entries.en: You can't say that.{E108:0010} You don't have conclusive proof.
entries.ru: Этого вы утверждать не можете.{E108:0010} Доказательств нет.

entries.en:
Nor do you have conclusive proof to the contrary...{E108:0010} so
let's not retread this tired old topic again.
entries.ru:
Как и у вас -- обратных...{E108:0010} Так что не станем
возвращаться к этому надоевшему спору.

entries.en:
She will go to trial,{E108:0008} and the Goddess will pass her
judgment.{E108:0010} There is nothing you can do to stop that.
entries.ru:
Её будут судить,{E108:0008} и Богиня вынесет свой
приговор.{E108:0010} Помешать этому вы не в силах.

entries.en: And there is nothing more to say on the subject.
entries.ru: И более об этом говорить нечего.

entries.en: Instead,{E108:0008} let us speak of the matter at hand.
entries.ru: Обратимся{E108:0008} лучше к делу насущному.

entries.en:
You may not be aware of this,{E108:0008} but you are only
permitted to meet with specially approved visitors.
entries.ru:
Возможно, вам неизвестно,{E108:0008} но видеться вам
дозволено лишь с особо утверждёнными посетителями.

entries.en:
So I'm to be treated like a dangerous criminal, am I?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}I suppose my reputation has rather plummeted...
entries.ru:
Со мной теперь как с опасным преступником?{E108:0010}
{E1D1}Похоже, репутация моя изрядно упала...

entries.en: It has indeed...{E108:0010} For you, of course,{E108:0008} and your friends.
entries.ru: И весьма...{E108:0010} У вас, разумеется,{E108:0008} и у ваших друзей.

entries.en:
That attorney and the other girl were raising quite the
fuss earlier.
entries.ru:
Тот адвокат и та девушка недавно
устроили изрядный шум.

entries.en: (Fender and Ema...)
entries.ru: (Защитин и Эма...)

entries.en:
I saw them launch some extremely heated words at
one of the guards.
entries.ru:
Я видела, как они наговорили охраннику
весьма горячих слов.

entries.en: No!{E108:0018} You didn't--!
entries.ru: Нет!{E108:0018} Вы же не--!

entries.en:
You may thank the Goddess in that regard.{E108:0010} For even
she is too busy to deal with each and every infraction.
entries.ru:
За это благодарите Богиню.{E108:0010} Даже у неё
не достаёт часа на всякий проступок.

entries.en: They will not be punished for their bad behavior.
entries.ru: За дурное поведение их не накажут.

entries.en:
...Did you come here just to chit-chat with me?{E108:0010}
You must have a lot of time on your hands.
entries.ru:
...Вы пришли просто поболтать?{E108:0010}
У вас, должно быть, много свободного времени.

entries.en:
Oh,{E108:0008} speaking of which,{E108:0010} Ms. von Karma is continuing
the investigation where you left off.
entries.ru:
Ах да,{E108:0008} кстати:{E108:0010} мисс фон Карма продолжает
следствие с того места, где вы его бросили.

entries.en:
I just thought you would like to know.{E108:0010} I figured you
would be worried about how they were all doing.
entries.ru:
Подумала, вам это будет любопытно.{E108:0010} Решила,
вы тревожитесь, как они там все.

entries.en: (I hate to admit it,{E108:0008} but she read me like a book...)
entries.ru:
(Признавать неприятно,{E108:0008} но она читает меня
как открытую книгу...)

entries.en:
Let's cut to the chase, Your Honor.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00000001}{E284}Why are you really here?
entries.ru:
Перейдём к делу, Ваша честь.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00000001}{E284}Зачем вы на самом деле пришли?

entries.en:
I'm here simply to talk.{E108:0010} Nothing more.{E108:0018}
There is something I wish to know about you.
entries.ru:
Просто поговорить.{E108:0010} И только.{E108:0018}
Есть нечто, что я хотела бы о вас узнать.
...Обо мне?

entries.en:
Objectively speaking,{E108:0008} you are highly intelligent and
quick-witted.
entries.ru:
Если судить непредвзято,{E108:0008} вы весьма умны
и находчивы.

entries.en: And a born prosecutor, at that.
entries.ru: И прокурор от рождения к тому же.

entries.en:
Please, Judge Gavèlle.{E108:0010}
Your sarcastic praise is but salt on my wounds.
entries.ru:
Помилуйте, судья Молотова.{E108:0010}
Ваша язвительная похвала -- соль на раны.

entries.en:
But I sincerely mean every word, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
And it is why I fail to understand you.
entries.ru:
Но я искренна в каждом слове, мистер Эджворт.{E108:0010}
Оттого я вас и не понимаю.

entries.en: Take this latest case, for example.
entries.ru: Возьмите хоть это последнее дело.

entries.en:
You were up against the very Committee itself.{E108:0010}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}You had no hope of succeeding.
entries.ru:
Вы пошли против самого Комитета.{E108:0010}
{E188:00310000}{E1D1}Надежды на успех у вас не было.

entries.en: Even a child could have seen that.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}And yet...
entries.ru: Это и ребёнку было видно.{E108:0010} {E107:0003}{E1D1}И всё же...

entries.en: Heh.
entries.ru: Хех.

entries.en:
I don't imagine the old me would've ever been so
reckless.
entries.ru:
Прежний я на такое безрассудство
никогда бы не пошёл.

entries.en:
The old me had power.{E108:0010} And because of that,{E108:0008} {E1D1}I thought
that justice was always on my side.
entries.ru:
У прежнего меня была власть.{E108:0010} И оттого{E108:0008} {E1D1}я думал,
что правосудие всегда на моей стороне.

entries.en: Just as you and the Committee believe now...
entries.ru: Ровно так же, как думаете сейчас вы и Комитет...

entries.en:
But a certain person changed my mind.{E108:0010} He made me
reckon with my selfish and skewed sense of justice.
entries.ru:
Но один человек меня переменил.{E108:0010} По его вине
я увидел, как своекорыстно и криво моё правосудие.

entries.en:
And once the scales had fallen from my eyes,{E108:0008} I began
to look at people differently.
entries.ru:
А когда пелена спала с глаз,{E108:0008} я стал
иначе смотреть на людей.

entries.en:
I saw that I was only able to be an effective prosecutor
thanks to the efforts of those around me.
entries.ru:
Я понял, что был хорошим прокурором
лишь трудами тех, кто был рядом.

entries.en:
Detective Gumshoe,{E108:0008} the many investigative officers of
the force...{E108:0010} and even Kay.
entries.ru:
Детектив Гамшу,{E108:0008} множество следователей
управления...{E108:0010} и даже Кей.

entries.en:
It changed me.{E108:0010} The degree to which it changed me still
surprises me to this day.
entries.ru:
Это меня переменило.{E108:0010} И до сих пор я сам
дивлюсь, насколько.

entries.en:
I see...{E108:0010} Thank you.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I feel that perhaps I understand you a little better now.
entries.ru:
Понимаю...{E108:0010} Благодарю.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}Кажется, теперь я понимаю вас чуть лучше.

entries.en: You?{E108:0010} Understand me?{E108:0018} {E1D1}I highly doubt it.
entries.ru: Вы?{E108:0010} Понимаете меня?{E108:0018} {E1D1}Сильно сомневаюсь.

entries.en:
Someone who is so focused on forcing their idea of
justice onto others{E108:0008} {E1D1}can't possibly see what I see.
entries.ru:
Тот, кто занят навязыванием своего правосудия
другим,{E108:0008} {E1D1}видеть того, что вижу я, не может.

entries.en:
...Is that so?{E108:0018}
Is that what you truly believe?
entries.ru:
...Вот как?{E108:0018}
Вы правда так считаете?

entries.en: I will say one thing.
entries.ru: Скажу одно.

entries.en:
This has been a very interesting conversation.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}{E188:00340000}...That is all.
entries.ru:
Разговор вышел весьма любопытный.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}{E188:00340000}...Только и всего.

entries.en: Before I go...{E108:0010} {E284}there is one remaining matter.
entries.ru: И напоследок...{E108:0010} {E284}осталось ещё одно дело.

entries.en:
I was asked to inform you that the date of your hearing
has been confirmed.
entries.ru:
Меня просили передать: день вашего слушания
назначен.

entries.en:
It will be held today.{E108:0010} In the trial chamber.{E108:0018}
The Committee sends its warmest regards.
entries.ru:
Оно состоится сегодня.{E108:0010} В судебном зале.{E108:0018}
Комитет шлёт вам сердечный привет.

entries.en:
...If that was all you had to tell me,{E108:0008} you could have just
sent a message.
entries.ru: ...Если это всё,{E108:0008} довольно было и записки.

entries.en:
And entrust the Goddess's words to another?{E108:0010}
That wouldn't do now, would it?
entries.ru:
Доверить слово Богини чужим устам?{E108:0010}
Это не годится, не так ли?

entries.en:
Until then, Mr. Edgeworth.{E108:0010}
I'll see you again very shortly.
entries.ru:
До встречи, мистер Эджворт.{E108:0010}
Увидимся совсем скоро.

entries.en:
April 6
{E20D}Detention Center - Holding Cell
(Do I have another visitor...?)
Kay!

Thank goodness you seem alright.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}That's a load off of my mind...

Ahh,{E108:0008} such a heartwarming scene...{E108:0018}
It's enough to...{E108:0008} {E1D1}*sniffle*{E108:0010} make a grown man cry...

But you're still not your usual cheery...{E108:0018}
I mean...{E108:0010} You have to stay positive, Kay.

You didn't do anything wrong.{E108:0010}
In fact,{E108:0008} I guarantee you didn't.

...No.{E108:0008} You have to let it go.{E108:0018}
{E280}I'm the murderer.{E108:0010} I know that now.

But you're not!{E108:0010} You can't be!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}{E188:00340000}{E1D1}Why don't you have any faith in yourself!?

How can I, Mr. Edgeworth...?{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}{E188:00300000}When there is no "me" left to believe in?
None at all?{E108:0018} {E188:00340000}{E1D1}I don't think that's true.

Before you lost your memory,{E108:0008} we spent quite a bit of
time together.
And I daresay{E108:0008} {E188:00300000}you left quite the impression on me.
So you see,{E108:0008} {E1D1}there's still plenty of you left.

That's why I believe so much in {E1D1}your innocence.{E108:0010}
And why you should believe in yourself, too.
...Thank you.

But...{E108:0010} I can't.{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E280}It would just cause more pain for the both of us.

Please.{E108:0010} You have to forget her.{E108:0010} Forget that Kay.{E108:0018}
{E188:00300000}She's gone.

You remind me of my younger self, you know.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}So noble...{E108:0010} So bold...

This...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E280}This is the justice you and the Committee stand
for?
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}{E1D1}Justice?{E108:0010} I suppose you could call it that.
(What is he up to?)

(Why is he going to such lengths to control
everything...?)

(I can't shake the feeling that something is very wrong
here.{E108:0010} {E188:00300000}Is there some hidden agenda at play?)

(Arngh!{E108:0010} This is no time to second guess myself!{E108:0018}
{E188:00340000}{E1D1}If I'm going to find out what it is,{E108:0008} it's now or never!)
Well then, my boy,{E108:0008} I suppose I should be...
Wait!

Why is the chairman so intent on seeing Kay charged
with this murder?{E108:0018} {E107:0001}{E188:00300000}It doesn't make any sense.
There must be some rhyme or reason to this madness.
Come now, Miles.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I'm a busy, important man.
I can't be wasting my precious time talking to you.

(The only way out of our current predicament is
through Chairman Winner!)
There's so much to ask,{E108:0008} and so little time.

Let's start by trying to find out {E285}{E043}why he rushed to have
Kay arrested so quickly{E040}.

I can't just let this happen!{E108:0020}
{E107:0001}I'm getting answers,{E108:0010} {E283}{E173:0000}if it's the last thing I do!
Kay is innocent!
No, no, no, my boy.{E108:0010} That's just clumsy.

Anyone can blurt out a baseless assertion like that.{E108:0010}
Even a disgraced superstar prosecutor.
Nngh...!

It's no good...{E108:0010} I don't have enough information to take
this any further just yet...

But my chance will come!{E108:0018}
I'll just have to be ready when it does!
Time to deploy {E285}my {E041}clue{E040}...
Kay was framed!

The true culprit set it all up so she would take the fall
instead!

That is my answer!{E108:0018}
{E107:0001}And I won't let you deny it any longer!
It's a bit of a shame you chose to hand in your badge.
I admit it.{E108:0010} You're right on all accounts.
And that's checkmate...!

Why were you so keen to push through Kay's arrest!?{E108:0010}
I've yet to hear a satisfactory explanation.

An explanation?{E108:0018}
I'm not entirely sure what you mean.
Don't give me that!{E108:0010} You know exactly what I mean!

Tut{E108:0008} {E1D1}tut.{E108:0018} I advise you to moderate your tone, dear boy.{E108:0010}
Need I remind you of your position?

And suppose we did let your friend go free.{E108:0010}
{E285}What then, hm?
...What do you mean{E108:0008} "what then"?

Think how that would look, my boy.{E108:0010} And who would
have to take the blame.{E108:0010} {E1D1}Me,{E108:0008} that's who.

You're right to keep your mouth shut.{E108:0010}
That way,{E108:0008} you won't say anything foolish.

.........{E107:0002}Sorry,{E108:0008} but I can't stay silent forever.{E108:0018}
{E12F:00000009}{E282}{E107:0001}Not while Kay's innocence is still in doubt!

Ahh,{E108:0008} you're breaking my heart...{E108:0008} *sob*{E108:0018}
{E1D1}Just look at this flood of tears...{E1D1}{E12F:00250008}{E112:0025}{E12F:00250004} spilling out...

P-Please...{E108:0010} just leave it alone, will you?{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Things were coming along nicely until you interfered.

"Coming along nicely"...?{E108:0018} {E107:0002}That's a pretty strange way
of putting it.
...It's almost as if you wanted Kay's arrest to happen.

It certainly doesn't sound like the statement of an
impartial representative of the law.

Hmm...{E108:0010} You think so?{E108:0018}
Well,{E108:0008} that wasn't my intention.

Has it occurred to you that you might just be
overthinking things a little?

Chairman Winner certainly knows how to dodge a
question.

But it doesn't change the fact that serious doubts
remain concerning Kay's arrest.

Next we'll need to press him on whether he really
believes {E043}the investigation was sufficient{E040}.

We can't allow any of his statements to go
unexamined,{E108:0008} no matter how trivial they may seem.

One of them may just give us {E283}{E173:0000}the breakthrough we
need!

How much time was spent on your investigation
altogether?

Well now,{E108:0008} let's see...{E108:0018}
You know what?{E108:0010} I'm not sure I can remember...

And I'm sure you can!{E108:0018}
You won't bluster your way out of this one!

It's not bluster, my boy.{E108:0010} I honestly don't recall.{E108:0010}
It's a problem when you get to my age, you see...
Why,{E108:0008} I even forget my own son's name sometimes.

Never mind your fool of a son!{E108:0018} Answer me!{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E280}How long did you spend on the investigation!?

*sniffle*{E108:0010} Y-You're right, of course...{E108:0010} The boy's a fool...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}I never meant for him to grow up like that, but...
Ohhhh,{E108:0008} {E1D1}woe is me...{E108:0008} {E1D1}*sniffle*

He's only too happy to derail the conversation no
matter where I take it.

I have to force him to take this seriously.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Let's try another tack for now.
My, my.{E108:0010} You really don't give up, do you?
But even my patience...{E108:0010} {E12F:00250006}has its limits, you know.
What a coincidence.{E108:0010} So does mine.

Now answer the question!{E108:0010} Do you believe that your
investigation was sufficient or not?

Ahh,{E108:0008} the youth these days are wont to be reckless...{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}Makes me want to put you in your place.
You're going to regret that, my boy.

Well, well.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}Maybe you do know your place after all.
What's the matter?{E108:0010} Scared?{E108:0010} {E1D1}Oh-ho-ho.

Hmph.{E108:0010} Hardly.{E108:0010} I was just thinking about how best to
proceed.

Getting answers from the elderly requires sensitivity.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}They can get quite emotional, after all.
You have no common sense whatsoever, do you?
Don't you understand?{E108:0010} Your fate {E1D1}rests in my hands.

Let's say you do manage to "get some answers" from
me.

There's nothing you can do with them.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}So why not give it up, dear boy?
...And why not?

It's simple.{E108:0018} {E12F:00000009}Because I'm not about to let the truth
escape me!

Interesting.{E108:0010} {E1D1}I think I'm beginning to see what makes
you tick.

But what you're doing is pointless.{E108:0018}
{E281}{E12F:00250004}Tragically...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0008} and miserably pointless...

P-Please,{E108:0008} just...{E108:0010} give up.{E108:0008} *sob*{E12F:00250008}{E112:0025}{E12F:00250004} Sh-She's guilty.{E108:0010}
{E1D1}The decision has been made...
Once again,{E108:0008} your choice of words intrigues me...

It's almost as if Kay's guilt had already been
determined from before her arrest.
.........{E107:0002}{E1D1}What are you trying to imply?

I'm implying...{E108:0010} {E285}that things haven't gone as they
normally should.

In fact,{E108:0008} everything has proceeded as if Kay's arrest was
the end goal,{E108:0008} right from the very start.
Well, Chairman Winner?{E108:0018} Was it?
.........{E107:0002}{E284}That's certainly an intriguing theory.

But it's also a complete work of fiction.{E108:0010} And I'm afraid
I don't have time for such flights of fancy.

I think it's time we brought this shabby little farce to
an end,{E108:0010} {E281}{E12F:00250005}don't you?
N-No!{E108:0018} {E281}{E172:00350000}He's trying to make his escape!

We must confirm {E043}the legality of Kay's arrest{E040} before he

It's faint,{E108:0008} but the truth is finally beginning to emerge.
And I'm not about to let this opportunity pass me by!
You can hardly say your investigation was sufficient!

And you're the one who called all the shots,{E108:0008} weren't
you?{E108:0010} Including the decision to have Kay arrested?

Oh-ho-ho.{E108:0010} I'm afraid I'm nowhere near as influential as
you think, dear boy.

You're the chairman of the Committee.{E108:0010}
It doesn't get much more influential than that.
Not that I care about such things.

You wound me!{E108:0018}
{E107:0003}{E1D1}It's enough...{E108:0010} {E12F:00250004}to drive an old man to tears...
You'll have to forgive me.{E108:0010} I'm not the deferential type.
W-Well if you're going to insist on being {E1D1}so blunt...

...th-then I'm afraid you won't be seeing your
{E1D1}prosecutor's badge again anytime soon...{E108:0008} *sniffle*
Let me make something clear once and for all.

That badge isn't the be-all, end-all for me.{E108:0018}
Far from it!

I'm not concerned with titles or roles.{E108:0018}
{E283}Even you must understand that much.
So young...{E108:0018} {E107:0002}{E281}So very young...

A word of advice, Miles,{E108:0008} from somebody who's been
around the block.
You're hopelessly naive, my boy.{E108:0018} {E283}{E12F:00250005}{E1D1}Idiotically so!
Well, that certainly got under his skin...!

He might be less guarded in his answers while he's in
this state.
Now's my chance!
Wait!{E108:0018} {E107:0001}We're not done yet!

I'm...{E108:0008} tired of all this talking...{E108:0010}
{E107:0002}So make it brief, will you?

Who gave the order?{E108:0010} {E1D1}{E1D5}Who decided that Kay should be
arrested?
Hmm...{E108:0010} {E1D1}You know...{E108:0010} {E107:0002}I can't seem to remember...

Don't ever get old, Miles, my boy.{E108:0010}
It wreaks havoc on the memory.

I don't have {E285}a {E041}clue{E040} as to how to proceed with this line
of questioning.
I'd better try another tack for now.
Time to deploy {E285}my {E041}clue{E040}...
I'd appreciate it if you'd stop playing the old man card.

You remembered the details of the evidence against
Kay pretty clearly.

Perhaps if your memory didn't fail you only when it
was convenient,{E108:0008} {E283}I'd be more inclined to believe you!

So, let me ask you again:{E108:0010} {E1D1}Who gave the order for Kay's

You're a sharp one,{E108:0008} I'll give you that.{E108:0018}
{E1D1}My son could learn a thing or two from you.

If he wasn't such an incurable numbskull, that is...{E108:0018}{E281}{E12F:00250004}{E108:0010}
{E1D1}It's a tragedy, really...{E108:0008} {E1D1}*sniffle*

I don't want to hear about your son!{E108:0018} {E283}I want to know
who authorized the arrest!

Y-You're very mean.{E108:0010} You know that, don't you...?{E108:0008}
{E1D1}*sniffle*
The arrest, you say?{E108:0010} I believe the order was given by...

Come now, Chairman Winner.{E108:0010}
{E188:00300000}We both know it was {E1D1}you.
Alright,{E108:0010} {E1D1}you got me.

You...{E108:0010} You make it sound like it was somehow {E1D1}a bad
thing, though...

But I have a reputation to uphold,{E108:0008} so I guess I'd better
clear up this little misunderstanding.

I'll entertain your questions for a few more minutes.{E108:0018}
{E280}{E12F:00250002}Let's see if I can't put your mind at ease.
The key thing to do now...

...is to establish {E284}{E1D1}{E043}how intimately he knows the details of
the case{E040}.
I just have to ask the right questions...!

The endgame is at hand!{E108:0018}
{E1D3}{E188:00200000}We're but a few moves away from the truth!
Based on everything I've heard from you so far...
...it's clear that Kay's arrest {E188:00300000}is entirely unfounded.

Yes, yes.{E108:0010} I think we're all familiar with this particular
refrain of yours by now.

But I'm afraid it doesn't matter either way.{E108:0010} You don't

How dare you take this so lightly as a man of the law!?
My, my.{E108:0010} Aren't you a rude little boy?
But my fuse...{E108:0020} {E1D1}{E12F:00250005}is only so long.

Honestly speaking,{E108:0008} I don't have the time to waste on
{E1D1}every last question you can dream up.

I have certain responsibilities to attend to, you know.{E108:0010}
{E12F:00250008}I really am quite the busy man.
Or are you just pretending to be busy, hm?

Th-That's...{E108:0008} *sniffle*{E108:0010} {E107:0002}an awful thing to say to a fragile

I ask you, my boy...{E108:0008}*sob*{E108:0010} what could I even hope to

You obviously don't want to talk about the case
anymore.

That's why you're so keen to get out of this
conversation, isn't it?

It's just so tragic...{E108:0010} it really is...{E108:0008} *sob*{E108:0018}
{E107:0002}{E1D1}That you would suspect me of such things...
It's not a suspicion.{E108:0010} {E285}It's a certainty.

There were no clear grounds on which to base Kay's
arrest, for a start.

Now, now, my boy.{E108:0010} Let's not get carried away.{E108:0010}
There was plenty of evidence to support our case.

The mask,{E108:0008} the letter,{E108:0008} the corsage...{E108:0010}
{E1D5}These were all in her possession.
And,{E108:0008} of course...{E108:0010} her confession.
More than enough to prove her guilt, I'd say.
But those are...

...What's the matter?{E108:0010} Struggling to come up with a way
to explain everything away?
Well,{E108:0008} there we have it.{E108:0010} Your silence speaks volumes.

It's true I can't counter your argument right now...{E108:0010}
(...but you did let something valuable slip.)

(A {E043}suspiciously detailed knowledge of the evidence
against Kay{E042}...)
